LightningComponentBundle.description: Formula Builder (ISS-002768) — Interactive formula editor LWC. View mode shows the current formula stored in the configured field. Edit mode exposes System Variables, Fields, Functions and Operators comboboxes that insert tokens at the cursor, a live formula textarea, and a Verify modal that syntax-checks the formula against a sample record before saving it back to the record via the Update button.

property.name: targetObjectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object that owns the formula field (e.g. Study_Requirement_Set__c). On a record page this is usually inherited from context but can be overridden here.

property.name: targetFieldApiName
property.label: Formula Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field that stores the formula string (e.g. Criteria__c).

property.name: allowEdit
property.label: Allow Editing
property.description: Show the Edit button and allow users to modify the formula. Set to false for a read-only display.

property.name: enableDebugMode
property.label: Enable Debug Logging
property.description: When true, verbose debug statements are written to the browser console via logInfo. Disable in production.
